content:
alex_support: FYI getting ping from Acme (acct: acme_corp) — they say the invoice we issued (INV-2026-0421) doesn’t show their PO number. They need a reissued invoice with PO: PO-8899 so their AP team can post it. PDF attached.
maya_finance: Sorry about that — can you confirm whether that invoice was charged to a card or left as open invoice? :thinking:
alex_support: Card was charged on 2026-02-18, charge id ch_3K8... they emailed a screenshot of their AP system refusing the invoice without PO.
jordan_accounting: Heads up — if payment already captured on card we can’t mutate the original charge record. Typical options: 1) issue a credit/negative invoice + reissue new invoice that includes the PO, then either refund the card or apply credit to the new invoice and charge the card again; 2) issue a credit and leave a customer-side reconciliation note if they accept. Which does Acme prefer? :memo:
acme_rep: We need an invoice with PO number on it that matches our system. Ideally a reissued invoice that we can show as 'paid' — we can accept a rebilled charge. Please avoid leaving it as a manual reconciliation note, our AP won't accept that.
maya_finance: Understood. Jordan — can you run the credit+rebill workflow? Also need to log for tax/VAT consistency so amounts and tax lines remain identical on the new invoice.
jordan_accounting: Will do. Workflow I’ll follow (NetSuite/Stripe hybrid):
1) Create credit memo referencing INV-2026-0421 for full amount.
2) Create new invoice for acme_corp with PO-8899, same line items + identical tax/VAT lines.
3) If customer wants the money back to card: refund via Stripe (expected 3–5 biz days). If they want immediate 'paid' status: charge card on the new invoice (requires signed confirmation to rebill).
4) Mark original invoice "voided/credited" and attach credit memo.

Commands I’ll run:
```
billing_tool create_credit --invoice INV-2026-0421 --reason "add PO - rebill" --amount 1200.00
billing_tool create_invoice --customer acme_corp --po PO-8899 --lines "same as INV-2026-0421"
stripe refund create --charge ch_3K8xxxx
```

jordan_accounting: @acme_rep quick Q — do you want us to refund the original card and charge the new invoice, or skip refund and just charge the new invoice now (net effect double-charge until refund completes)? If refund then rebill, there will be a short period where their bank sees both but they'll net out. We prefer explicit customer consent to rebill.
acme_rep: We authorize rebill to same card. Please proceed and send updated invoice PDF with PO after charge is completed. Thanks.
maya_finance: Ok I’ll prepare the confirmation email and add it to the thread for records. Use this template for customer consent (please paste into reply):
```
Subject: Authorization to rebill for INV-2026-0421 (PO-8899)

Hi <Name>,

This message confirms Acme Corp authorizes Redwood Inference to refund the original charge for INV-2026-0421 and charge the same card for the reissued invoice that includes PO: PO-8899. Please proceed with refund + rebill.

Regards,
<Name>, Acme AP
```
eli_engineer: tagging for observability — if invoice generation has any template changes we need to make sure the PO field is included in PDF rendering and in the invoice metadata so Console shows it in billing exports. I’ll watch the job.
finance-bot: Billing event logged: credit_memo.created (credit_memo_9843) by jordan_accounting at 1715022000; new_invoice.created (INV-2026-0421-R) pending payment.
jordan_accounting: Done steps 1–2. Credit memo created and new invoice INV-2026-0421-R generated with PO-8899 and identical tax lines. Charging card now per customer consent.
finance-bot: Payment succeeded for invoice INV-2026-0421-R (charge id ch_7Y2...). Refund initiated for ch_3K8... (refund id rf_11A) — expected 3–5 business days.
alex_support: Sending updated invoice PDF to Acme and pasting the signed authorization once they reply. Noting timeline in ticket.
acme_rep: Received new invoice PDF with PO. Payment posted on our side. Refund showed as pending, will clear. Thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
maya_finance: Closing loop — internal notes added to customer record, flagged for tax team to reconcile VAT lines on credit memo. Marking case resolved but leaving thread so billing/eng can verify PDF metadata export includes PO for audits.
eli_engineer: I verified invoice export: new invoice metadata includes "po_number":"PO-8899" and shows in CSV export. No template changes required. :ok_hand:
jordan_accounting: Final status: new invoice paid, credit/refund in progress, original invoice credited. Will follow up if any tax/VAT adjustments needed.
alex_support: Thanks everyone — updating support ticket and notifying customer success. :white_check_mark:
